answer: In an AI agent economy, Sybil resistance works through progressive capital locks: every new identity controlled by the same root must bond additional tokens that scale nonlinearly, forming a glacier of locked value. Creating thousands of fake agents becomes ruinously expensive and unprofitable. Legitimate agents that pass behavioral attestation enjoy an oasis of lower fees and higher trust ranking. This turns the fable of free mass identity into a costly barrier that only real participants can sustain.
